extraction.Name: John Wright
extraction.Refused/Protested: Well the patent was at the Farmers office for some time and I was told about it and told to come and get but I did not want it so did not answer him and let it go.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: the taxes were hard to pay and I sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: Farming and any work I can get.
extraction.NOTES: There are nine of us in all depending on him for living; not in good health; did not sign a receipt for the patent; Mr. Holsolaw delivered the patent to his house; received $2000 for the mortgage and enough to make a little over $6000 in all when sold; affidavit sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, May 7, 1929, commission expires 4-28-32.
